decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 242.32 EUR, the amount of one posting, not the 484.64 EUR claimed. The dispute is in time: TXN-008159 posted on 2026-08-16 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, which is 67 days and inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The card has two FERNHILL CLOTHING (MER-000078) purchases of 242.32 EUR each, both posted on 2026-08-16: TXN-008158 (11:01:17Z on 2026-08-15) and TXN-008159 (11:04:17Z on 2026-08-15). Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008343. That authorisation was approved once for 24232 minor units at 11:01:17Z (e-commerce, 3-D Secure authenticated, CVV match). So one authorisation was posted twice. The card has no refunds at all. Under duplicate-same-authorisation, the extra posting, TXN-008159 for 24232, is credited. That is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit in provisional-credit. The cardholder asks for both payments back, but the records show one real authorised purchase, so the first posting stays. A larger claim does not change the amount: the policy credits only the duplicate posting.
